qualityContract.search: exhaustive over recorded grid; no monotonicity assumption
qualityContract.qualityMatched: smallest candidate meeting common SSIM floor; null means unmet
qualityContract.byteMatched: highest SSIM within common byte cap; null means unmet
qualityContract.reference: sharp auto-orient, resize to at most 320px wide, composite on white, PNG; identical for both encoders
qualityContract.limits: SSIM is a proxy, not human perceptual equivalence. Alpha composited here; compiler suite tests preservation. Codec-only, not compiler E2E. Hostile inputs excluded and tested separately by compiler suite.
qualityContract.timing: three sequential encodes per candidate; p50/p90/worst nearest rank; process isolated per fixture/format/engine; no universal speed claim
qualityContract.rss: sampled every 10ms in isolated fixture/format/engine process, includes reference and quality measurement; not encoder-only RSS

unavailableScopes: candidate/output pixels not retained in original artifact
compiler full output-set bytes/digests (only budgeted byte counts and large JPEG size retained)
